reports.title: Park Hotels & Resorts Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Full-Year 2026 Outlook
section: Park is increasing its full-year 2026 outlook to reflect strong third quarter results and demand trends expected for the fourth quarter.
Park expects full-year 2026 operating results to be as follows:

(unaudited, dollars in millions, except per share amounts and RevPAR) | Full-Year 2026 Outlookas of November 4, 2026 | Full-Year 2026 Outlookas of August 6, 2026 | Change at Midpoint
Metric | Low | High | Low | High
Comparable RevPAR(1) | 205 | 206 | 198 | 201 | 6
Comparable RevPAR change vs. 2025(1) | 5.5 | 6.0 | 3.0 | 4.5 | 200 | bps
Net income | 70 | 80 | 78 | 98 | (13)
Net income attributable to stockholders | 62 | 72 | 69 | 89 | (12)
Earnings per share – Diluted(2) | 0.31 | 0.36 | 0.35 | 0.45 | (0.07)
Adjusted EBITDA | 635 | 645 | 617 | 637 | 13
Adjusted FFO per share – Diluted(2) | 2.00 | 2.05 | 1.90 | 2.00 | 0.08
